name: Autonomica
detailed_description:
Join our Discord


Over Million Raised on Kickstarter


About the Game

Time is broken. So is the world. But maybe you can fix both.

Autonomica is an open-world survival game playable solo or with friends, inspired by solarpunk aesthetics and driven by farming, automation with organic products, exploration, and futuristic tech. Build automated farms that turn tomatoes into truckloads, craft advanced machines, and explore islands filled with mysteries, strange phenomena, and time-bending challenges.

THE WORLD OF AUTONOMICA

We're creating a world designed around harnessing clean energy, from cozy farms to solar-powered mega-factories. Every task, like watering crops, harvesting resources, or running production lines, can be done manually if you enjoy staying hands-on. Automation is available when you choose to use it, allowing you to streamline routine tasks and free up time to explore, build, and shape the world at your own pace. Grow organic crops, manufacture synthetic products, and steadily expand your farming operation.

FARMING, BUT NOT LIKE YOU REMEMBER

Forget the peaceful countryside routine. This world is dynamic – with real-time weather, seasons, and a living day/night cycle. Crops require light, warmth, and water to thrive. Boost growth by creating optimal enclosures, and monitor stats like plant happiness, efficiency, and yield quality. Want better tomatoes? Treat them right.

🛠 BUILD & AUTOMATE

In Autonomica, you’ll harness natural resources to power up sprawling production lines. Use structural blocks, machines, and conveyor systems to automate crop growth, product fabrication, and even animal care. From humble tomato replicators to full-blown processing hubs – every system is yours to design and optimize.

ENGINEER YOUR FUTURE

Unlock technologies across multiple stations:

  • Drafting Station – Automate construction, power, and mechanical systems

  • Botanical Station – Advance your crop, animal, and enclosure tech

  • Cooking Station – Process natural goods into high-value food products

Your workshop becomes a playground for innovation – or survival.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR WORLD

In Autonomica, construction is fully modular and player-driven. Whether you're putting together a cozy cottage, a sleek greenhouse, or a sprawling automation hub carved into a mountainside, every structure begins with your own design.

Design your home with furniture, colors, and layouts that matter. Place the right props to unlock room bonuses that affect your stats, relationships, and NPC interactions. From solar-lit bedrooms to tech-packed labs – your space reflects your playstyle.

NIGHT BELONGS TO PHANTOMS

When the sun sets, they appear.
Phantoms – unstable beings born from time rift experiments – haunt the forests. Track them, fight them, and capture their essence using high-tech tools like the Hydro Blaster and Protovac. Store their atomized forms in Nanotainers, and use their power to supercharge your production.

TRAVEL TO THE FUTURE

Venture into unstable timelines through Time Capsules and take on three high-risk gameplay modes:

  • Extraction Mode – Peaceful exploration with limited-time rewards

  • PVE Mode – Face dangerous Phantoms and powerful boss entities

  • PVP Mode – Compete against other players and Phantoms in survival arenas

Return with rare crops, animals, and tech – if you make it back.

GAME HIGHLIGHTS

  • 🌎 Massive Open World – No loading screens or forced sleep mechanics; explore diverse handcrafted biomes packed with secrets, resources, and countless adventures.

  • 🎶 Romantic Retro Sci-Fi & Synthwave – Immerse yourself in a nostalgic, romantic atmosphere filled with chunky retro electronics, stylish aesthetics, and an evocative synthwave soundtrack.

  • 🎨 Character Customization – Customize your character, build your skills, and discover unique hairstyles, outfits, and accessories in charming local shops.

  • 🌱 Farming & Ranching – Grow over 100 variations of crops, raise and breed bondable animals, and build eco-farms that manage themselves seamlessly, without micromanagement.

  • ⚙️ Deep Automation Systems – Minimalistic conveyor line design elegantly integrates with solarpunk aesthetics, electric grids, and dynamic water pipelines to automate everything from dairy factories to drone-based deliveries.

  • 🧱 Detailed Construction – Construct anything from massive structures to cozy homes, customize interiors, and craft your perfect living space.

  • 🏗️ Dynamic Environment – Help NPCs repair buildings, revive businesses, and upgrade towns by providing resources and watching communities flourish.

  • 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 NPCs & Relationships – Form friendships, romances, or marriages with dynamic NPCs who respond authentically to your actions, outfits, and progress.

  • ⛈️ Dynamic Weather & Seasons – Experience seamless day-night cycles and weather events like rain, fog, or snow without loading screens.

  • 🛸 Vehicles & Exploration – Traverse islands using futuristic vehicles like hoverboards, buggies, and powerful mechs to uncover hidden secrets.

  • 👻 Ghost-Hunting & Night Exploration – Brave the darkness to hunt ghostly Phantoms, capture their mysterious energy, and unlock powerful new technology.

  • ⏳ Time Travel Adventures – Navigate fractured timelines, explore alternate worlds filled with unique creatures and crops, and influence the future by uncovering hidden secrets of the past.

  • 🕹️ Multiplayer & PvEvP Mode – Explore solo or with friends, and challenge yourself with PvEvP Extraction modes, competing for loot across alternate timelines.

  • 🎮 Play Your Way – Choose your experience from peaceful exploration to challenging survival. Enjoy intuitive controls and customizable difficulty levels, and engage in PvP, PvE, or calmer, creative gameplay.

  • 🤝 Cooperative Automation – Team up with friends to design and manage sprawling automated farms, factories, and thriving settlements together.

  • 🤔 We're Probably Missing Something Here – We have so many exciting features in production and we're racing against time, so chances are we've forgotten to list something awesome here!

  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT 6 GB

  • Storage: 30 GB available space
